description: Captures Delivery Optimization telemetry JSON after a DO download completes. Contains file size, peer caching stats, download mode, and duration. IME removed the [DO TEL] emitter in 1.104 (absent in 1.104.102.0 and 1.105.103.0 decompiles, present in 1.97.107.0); kept while 1.101/1.103 devices are in the fleet — retire once those versions are gone.
